units.source_text: “我的意思只不过是，要是为了我请客，那就算了。

en.t: What I mean is simply that if you are inviting guests for my sake, then please do not.

units.source_text: 如果二老怕人家背后说闲话，那是另一码事。

en.t: If you two are afraid people will gossip behind your backs, that is another matter.

units.source_text: 对你们不利的事，我坚持也没有用。”

en.t: There is no point in my insisting on something that would harm you.

units.source_text: “你怎么都有理啊。”

en.t: You always manage to make yourself sound right.

units.source_text: 父亲不高兴了。

en.t: Father became displeased.

units.source_text: “虽然你爸没说请客是为了你，

en.t: Even if your father has not said the guests are being invited for your sake,

units.source_text: 可你也不该一点人情世故都不懂吧。”

en.t: you ought to understand at least a little about social obligation.

units.source_text: 一到这种时候，母亲就爱讲一通女人家那套驴唇不对马嘴的歪理，

en.t: At times like this, Mother liked to launch into a womanly sort of muddled, ill-fitting reasoning.

units.source_text: 若论碎嘴唠叨，父亲和我加起来都别想说过她。

en.t: When it came to chatter and nagging, Father and I together could not hope to outtalk her.

units.source_text: “念了点儿书，就总是认死理儿，这怎么行？”

en.t: Once you have had a little schooling, you cling to logic all the time; that will never do.

units.source_text: 父亲只说了这样一句，

en.t: Father said only that one sentence,

units.source_text: 但是，我从这句话中，

en.t: but in those words,

units.source_text: 看到了父亲平时对我的所有不满。

en.t: I saw all the dissatisfaction Father had always felt toward me.

units.source_text: 当时我并没有发觉自己说话尖刻，

en.t: At the time I did not notice how sharp my own words had been,

units.source_text: 只觉得父亲不该那么责备我。

en.t: and only felt that Father should not have blamed me like that.

units.source_text: 那天晚上，父亲又恢复了心情，

en.t: That evening, Father recovered his good mood,

units.source_text: 来问我，要是请客，安排在哪一天好。

en.t: and came to ask me what day would be best if they invited the guests.

units.source_text: 对我这个每天无所事事、闲待在家里的人，

en.t: To me, who had nothing to do each day and simply idled at home,

units.source_text: 父亲还来问我哪天方便，

en.t: Father's asking which day suited me

units.source_text: 这就等于向我让步了。

en.t: amounted to his yielding to me.

units.source_text: 在慈祥的父亲面前，我自然温顺下来，

en.t: Before my kindly father, I naturally became docile,

units.source_text: 和父亲商量之后，决定了请客的日期。

en.t: and after discussing it with him, we decided on the date for the invitation.

units.source_text: 在那天还没到来的时候，发生了一件大事，

en.t: Before that day arrived, a major event occurred,

units.source_text: 即明治天皇贵体有恙的通告。

en.t: namely the announcement that Emperor Meiji was ill.

units.source_text: 这条新闻通过报纸即刻传遍了整个日本，

en.t: The news spread at once throughout all Japan by way of the newspapers,

units.source_text: 也把一个农家几经周折刚刚决定的毕业庆祝宴会，

en.t: and even the graduation celebration banquet at a farmhouse, finally settled after many turns,

units.source_text: 吹得烟消云散了。

en.t: was blown away until nothing remained.

units.source_text: “还是暂时取消的好。”

en.t: It would be better to cancel it for the time being.
